name: Labeled Sample Compression / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The six-cube has LSC two but projected NCTD three. On the full cube of dimension $6r$, LSC is at most $2r$ and projected NCTD is $3r$. This excludes projected NCTD at most LSC plus a universal additive constant, and requires coefficient at least $3/2$ in any universal reverse affine bound. No unbounded-ratio separation is asserted.
proof_source: Full comparison argument in the LaTeX survey: cor:compression-nctd-gap. Endpoint value proofs are database-owned.
witness_verification: The six-cube endpoint values are two and three; both parameters have linear order on full cubes, so the witness is strict rather than an unbounded ratio. The decoder is replayed by sync/verify_six_cube_compression.py.
references: For the earlier strict separation and NCTD values: \cite{KSZ2019}, Theorem 19 and Proposition 28(2). The stronger slope uses the cube projection identity and the database-owned six-cube compression proof via survey cor:compression-nctd-gap.
